LanguageData.TM_BreachSeal_eff_desc: Reduces mana cost by 10% per level, up to three levels.
LanguageData.TM_BreachSeal_NoCore: Select a platform belonging to your ship core.
LanguageData.TM_BreachSeal_AmbiguousCore: More than one ship core owns this platform.
LanguageData.TM_BreachSeal_CoreOverlap: The target overlaps the ship core.
LanguageData.TM_BreachSeal_InvalidFloor: The center and far edge require intact ship floor.
LanguageData.TM_BreachSeal_ver_desc: Adds 25% of the base duration per level: 30, 36 or 42 hours. Scrolls and staves remain at 24 hours.
